goal: Upload backend (U1, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 'Round 7: upload'): app/upload.py begin/write/finish/cleanup/empty/safe/cap_message/OWNED and the routes POST /upload, PUT /upload/{batch}, POST /upload/{batch}/done with lifespan cleanup; no python-multipart.

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /upload with [{path,size}] returns 200 {batch}; an empty list, a duplicate path and unsafe paths ('../x', '/x', 'C:x', 'a//b', NUL) return 400 and create nothing; backslashes become '/'; upload.safe returns None for unsafe paths

PUT /upload/{batch}?path=... streams the body to disk in chunks (request.stream, no multipart); unknown batch 404; a path not in the batch's list 400; the file is written inside the batch folder, which lives under the system temp dir (prefix databoot-upload-), outside /work and outside any launcher folder

POST /upload/{batch}/done returns {'next': '/scan'}, sets DATABOOT_DATA to the batch folder, deletes the previous upload folder (never a folder outside upload.OWNED), and clears catalog.scan, catalog.load and main._base/_view/_plain/_detected/_appview caches; unknown batch 404

Uploading one file, several files, and files_of(data_dir) (a folder with sub/ and unreadable files) then GET /api/datasets lists the same path (sub/sales.csv kept), rows, columns and detected app as a client started on that folder; a second upload replaces the first one's data (no stale rows from a same-named file)

AC-77: with DATABOOT_UPLOAD_CAP small, a declared total over the cap returns 413 at POST /upload; a PUT whose real bytes pass the cap returns 413 and deletes the whole batch folder; detail is upload.cap_message, which names '2 GB' at the default cap and the launcher's '-Folder' option (e.g. 'This upload is 2.4 GB and the limit is 2 GB. For larger drives, start DataBoot with the launcher's -Folder option.'); nothing of that upload is listed afterwards

AC-76: using TestClient as a context manager, the temp folder exists during the run and is gone after exit; a launcher folder passed to launch.run is left unchanged; begin deletes a batch that was begun and never finished
New tests in tests/test_upload.py use the existing conftest upload()/files_of() helpers; python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_upload.py tests/test_app.py passes
